watches.name: HU-01 Finale “Yu”
watches.description: With every project that we do we feel a proper finale is needed, so what better way to close the chapter of the HU-01, a Finale series! 🙏 Exactly the same principles as before, inspired by the classic vintage Patek 96 Calatrava from the 1930s, but now paying tribute to a different and extremely exclusive design cue from that era. 💎 PRE-ORDERS / ALLOCATIONS AVAILABLE UNTIL THE 14TH JUNE 2026 (30 DAYS)! Delivery estimated to be around September 2026 period! Please read our FAQ before placing your allocation/pre-order!

watches.name: HU-01 Vintage White
watches.description: *PRE-ORDERS / ALLOCATIONS AVAILABLE UNTIL THE END OF NOVEMBER 2025! Keeping all the classic design cues from the good old days that we all love and adore, but with modern reliability. Mainly inspired by the vintage Patek 96 Calatrava from the 1930s, this watch was once disregarded even among many Patek collectors due to its small case size (only 31mm-32mm), but have since gotten more appreciation due to its beautiful and classic design, and especially with the collectors circle coming back to their senses and going back to loving elegant “smaller” cases.
